name: 传感器模式噪声 (PRNU)
description: 检测 光响应非均匀性 - a unique fingerprint left by each camera sensor. AI images lack this hardware-based identifier, making it a strong 取证 signal.
algorithm: 光响应非均匀性 (PRNU) Sensor Noise Fingerprint
mechanism: 提取 unique sensor noise fingerprint from the image. Every camera sensor has unique fixed-模式 noise. AI生成的 images lack any authentic PRNU 模式.
parameters: Denoising: BM3D / 小波, Correlation: normalized cross-相关性, 阈值: Neyman-Pearson
accuracy: 浏览器内较低 - 55-65%（无参考传感器）
source: Lukas et al. (2006), SPIE Image and Video Communications
useCase: Detecting absence of physical sensor noise fingerprint in AI生成的 images

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Goljan, M. et al. (2009). Large Scale Test of Sensor Fingerprint Camera Identification. SPIE.

strengths:
• Based on unique hardware sensor property
• Extremely difficult to forge sensor noise
• Well-established 取证 standard
• Can identify specific camera unit
limitations:
• Browser implementation has reduced 准确度
• Requires reference sensor fingerprint for best results
• Heavy processing/compression destroys PRNU
• Large flat images provide better estimates
